canonical:holding:0.label: Inverter Enabled
canonical:holding:0.description: Bitfield controlling remote enable of the inverter (bit 0) and the battery DC converter or BDC ready mode (bit 1). Write the combined value 0-3; 1 turns on the inverter, 2 turns on only the BDC, 3 turns on both.

metadata.note: Home Assistant preserves other control bits when toggling this value.

canonical:holding:0.tooltip: Home Assistant preserves other control bits when toggling this value.

canonical:holding:1.label: Safety function enable flags
canonical:holding:1.description: Bit mask that enables regional grid-protection functions. Set a bit to 1 to enable the corresponding feature (SPI, LVFRT, DRMS, Volt-Var, ROCOF, recovery, split-phase).

metadata.note: Bits 0-3 cover CEI 0-21 compliance; bits 4-6 cover AS/NZS/SAA requirements; bits 11-15 are reserved.

canonical:holding:1.tooltip: Bits 0-3 cover CEI 0-21 compliance; bits 4-6 cover AS/NZS/SAA requirements; bits 11-15 are reserved.

canonical:holding:2.label: Persist power-factor commands
canonical:holding:2.description: Choose whether the power-factor and derating commands in registers 3, 4, 5, and 99 are stored to NVRAM (1) or revert to defaults after the next restart (0).

canonical:holding:3.label: Active power limit setpoint
canonical:holding:3.description: Maximum active power output as a percentage of rated power. Values 0-100 cap the output; 255 removes the limit.

canonical:holding:4.label: Reactive power limit setpoint
canonical:holding:4.description: Maximum reactive power magnitude as a percent of rated capacity. Negative values request capacitive (leading) support, positive values inductive (lagging). 255 removes the limit.

canonical:holding:5.label: Power factor target
canonical:holding:5.description: Requested power factor multiplied by 10,000 (e.g. 9900 equals 0.99). Values below 10,000 lead (capacitive); values above 10,000 lag (inductive).

canonical:holding:6-7.label: Rated apparent power
canonical:holding:6-7.description: Apparent power capability encoded as an unsigned 32-bit value with 0.1 VA resolution (register 6 is the high word, register 7 the low word).

canonical:holding:8.label: Nominal PV voltage
canonical:holding:8.description: Target PV input voltage for maximum power point tracking, stored in 0.1 V increments.

canonical:holding:9-14.label: Firmware
canonical:holding:9-14.description: Six registers containing ASCII characters that describe the running firmware. Registers 9-11 hold the DSP identifier; registers 12-14 hold the control-board identifier. Home Assistant reads the combined 12-character string for the reported firmware version.

canonical:holding:15.label: LCD language selection
canonical:holding:15.description: Language index used by the local LCD interface: 0=Italian, 1=English, 2=German, 3=Spanish, 4=French, 5=Chinese, 6=Polish, 7=Portuguese, 8=Hungarian.

canonical:holding:16.label: Country profile configured
canonical:holding:16.description: Indicates whether a regional grid profile has been selected (1) or still needs to be chosen (0).

canonical:holding:17.label: PV start voltage threshold
canonical:holding:17.description: Minimum DC input voltage required before the inverter starts, stored in 0.1 V increments.

canonical:holding:18.label: Start-up delay
canonical:holding:18.description: Delay between meeting the PV start voltage and enabling the inverter output, measured in seconds.

canonical:holding:19.label: Restart delay
canonical:holding:19.description: Time to wait after a fault clears before restarting the inverter, in seconds.

canonical:holding:20.label: Active power ramp rate (startup)
canonical:holding:20.description: Slope for increasing active power after startup in 0.1% increments per second (1-1000).

canonical:holding:21.label: Active power ramp rate (restart)
canonical:holding:21.description: Slope for returning to full power after curtailment or a cleared fault, expressed in 0.1% per second.

canonical:holding:22.label: Modbus RTU baud rate
canonical:holding:22.description: Selects the RS-485 serial line baud rate: 0=9600 bps, 1=38400 bps.

canonical:holding:23-27.label: Serial Number

metadata.note: The Home Assistant integration exposes this as the device serial number and reuses it as the unique identifier.

canonical:holding:23-27.tooltip: The Home Assistant integration exposes this as the device serial number and reuses it as the unique identifier.

canonical:holding:28-29.label: Inverter Model
canonical:holding:28-29.description: 32-bit hardware option mask encoded as eight nibbles (A, B, D, T, P, U, M, S). Register 28 holds the high word and register 29 the low word.

metadata.note: Home Assistant renders this value as the string A# B# D# T# P# U# M# S# via the integration's model() helper. Vendor spec lists value pattern `&*5`; digits appear to be stored without the leading letter codes, so treat as encoded tokens until verified on hardware.

canonical:holding:28-29.tooltip: Home Assistant renders this value as the string A# B# D# T# P# U# M# S# via the integration's model() helper. Vendor spec lists value pattern `&*5`; digits appear to be stored without the leading letter codes, so treat as encoded tokens until verified on hardware.

canonical:holding:30.label: Modbus slave address
canonical:holding:30.description: RS-485/Modbus RTU slave ID. Set a value between 1 and 254; 0 is reserved for broadcast frames.

canonical:holding:31.label: Firmware update trigger
canonical:holding:31.description: Write 1 to arm the serial firmware update procedure. The inverter clears the flag after the bootloader handshake starts.

canonical:holding:32.label: Reset user configuration
canonical:holding:32.description: Writing 1 clears user-configurable settings such as communication parameters and regional profiles.

metadata.note: Use with caution; the inverter immediately reboots and loses provisioning data.

canonical:holding:32.tooltip: Use with caution; the inverter immediately reboots and loses provisioning data.

canonical:holding:33.label: Factory reset
canonical:holding:33.description: Writing 1 restores full factory defaults and restarts the inverter.

metadata.note: Equivalent to the front-panel factory reset. Requires re-commissioning afterwards.

canonical:holding:33.tooltip: Equivalent to the front-panel factory reset. Requires re-commissioning afterwards.

canonical:holding:34-41.label: Manufacturer information string
canonical:holding:34-41.description: Sixteen ASCII characters written at production time (batch, plant, or custom identifiers).

metadata.note: The original table lists these words as Manufacturer Info 8-1 (high/middle/low); combine them to read the full string.

canonical:holding:34-41.tooltip: The original table lists these words as Manufacturer Info 8-1 (high/middle/low); combine them to read the full string.

canonical:holding:42.label: G100 failsafe enable
canonical:holding:42.description: Enable (1) or disable (0) the UK G98/G100 failsafe watchdog.

metadata.note: Leave off unless the interconnection agreement requires the G100 failsafe mode.

canonical:holding:42.tooltip: Leave off unless the interconnection agreement requires the G100 failsafe mode.

canonical:holding:43.tooltip: Vendor spec provides value pattern `&*6`; handle as encoded type/family digits with implied prefixes pending confirmation.

canonical:holding:44.label: Number Of Trackers And Phases
canonical:holding:44.description: High byte holds the number of PV trackers; low byte holds the number of output phases.

canonical:holding:45.label: System clock year
canonical:holding:45.description: Calendar year stored by the internal real-time clock.

canonical:holding:46.description: Calendar month for the internal clock.

canonical:holding:47.description: Day of month for the internal clock.

canonical:holding:49.description: Minute component of the internal clock.

canonical:holding:51.label: System clock weekday
canonical:holding:51.description: Day-of-week index for the internal clock (0=Sunday, 6=Saturday).

canonical:holding:52.description: Grid voltage threshold for stage 1 undervoltage protection, stored in 0.1 V increments. Delay configured by register 68.

canonical:holding:55.description: Grid frequency threshold for stage 1 overfrequency protection (0.01 Hz increments). Delay configured by register 73.

canonical:holding:56.description: Grid voltage threshold for stage 2 undervoltage protection, stored in 0.1 V increments. Delay configured by register 70.

canonical:holding:59.description: Grid frequency threshold for stage 2 overfrequency protection (0.01 Hz increments). Delay configured by register 75.

canonical:holding:60.label: Stage 3 undervoltage limit
canonical:holding:60.description: Grid voltage threshold for stage 3 undervoltage protection, stored in 0.1 V increments. Delay configured by register 76.

canonical:holding:62.description: Grid frequency threshold for stage 3 underfrequency protection (0.01 Hz increments). Delay configured by register 78.

canonical:holding:63.label: Stage 3 overfrequency limit
canonical:holding:63.description: Grid frequency threshold for stage 3 overfrequency protection (0.01 Hz increments). Delay configured by register 79.

canonical:holding:64.label: Reconnect undervoltage limit
canonical:holding:64.description: Minimum grid voltage (0.1 V increments) required before reconnecting after a trip.

canonical:holding:65.label: Reconnect overvoltage limit
canonical:holding:65.description: Maximum grid voltage (0.1 V increments) allowed when reconnecting after a trip.

canonical:holding:66.description: Minimum grid frequency (0.01 Hz increments) required for reconnection.

canonical:holding:67.description: Maximum grid frequency (0.01 Hz increments) allowed when reconnecting.

canonical:holding:68.description: Number of cycles grid voltage must stay below the stage 1 undervoltage limit (register 52) before tripping. One AC cycle is 20 ms at 50 Hz (16.7 ms at 60 Hz).

canonical:holding:69.description: Cycles grid voltage must stay above the stage 1 overvoltage limit (register 53) before tripping. One AC cycle is 20 ms at 50 Hz (16.7 ms at 60 Hz).

canonical:holding:70.label: Stage 2 undervoltage trip delay
canonical:holding:70.description: Cycles grid voltage must stay below the stage 2 undervoltage limit (register 56) before tripping. One AC cycle is 20 ms at 50 Hz (16.7 ms at 60 Hz).

canonical:holding:71.label: Stage 2 overvoltage trip delay
canonical:holding:71.description: Cycles grid voltage must stay above the stage 2 overvoltage limit (register 57) before tripping. One AC cycle is 20 ms at 50 Hz (16.7 ms at 60 Hz).

canonical:holding:72.label: Stage 1 underfrequency trip delay
canonical:holding:72.description: Cycles grid frequency must stay below the stage 1 underfrequency limit (register 54) before tripping. One AC cycle is 20 ms at 50 Hz (16.7 ms at 60 Hz).

canonical:holding:73.label: Modbus Version
canonical:holding:73.description: Cycles grid frequency must stay above the stage 1 overfrequency limit (register 55) before tripping. One AC cycle is 20 ms at 50 Hz (16.7 ms at 60 Hz).

canonical:holding:74.label: Stage 2 underfrequency trip delay

canonical:holding:76.label: Stage 3 undervoltage trip delay
canonical:holding:76.description: Cycles grid voltage must stay below the stage 3 undervoltage limit (register 60) before tripping. One AC cycle is 20 ms at 50 Hz (16.7 ms at 60 Hz).

canonical:holding:77.label: Stage 3 overvoltage trip delay
canonical:holding:77.description: Cycles grid voltage must stay above the stage 3 overvoltage limit (register 61) before tripping. One AC cycle is 20 ms at 50 Hz (16.7 ms at 60 Hz).

canonical:holding:78.label: Stage 3 underfrequency trip delay
canonical:holding:78.description: Cycles grid frequency must stay below the stage 3 underfrequency limit (register 62) before tripping. One AC cycle is 20 ms at 50 Hz (16.7 ms at 60 Hz).

canonical:holding:79.label: Stage 3 overfrequency trip delay
canonical:holding:79.description: Cycles grid frequency must stay above the stage 3 overfrequency limit (register 63) before tripping. One AC cycle is 20 ms at 50 Hz (16.7 ms at 60 Hz).

canonical:holding:80.label: Ten-minute overvoltage limit
canonical:holding:80.description: Maximum RMS grid voltage averaged over 10 minutes (0.1 V increments) before the inverter trips.

canonical:holding:81.label: PV input high-voltage fault
canonical:holding:81.description: PV array voltage threshold that triggers a DC over-voltage fault (0.1 V increments).

canonical:holding:82-87.tooltip: Positions: 0-1 model letters, 2-3 model variant, 4-5 DSP1 build, 6-7 DSP2/M0 build, 8-9 CPLD/AFCI build, 10-11 M3 build.

canonical:holding:88.label: Modbus Version
canonical:holding:88.description: Modbus register map revision encoded as an integer (e.g. 207 equals version 2.07).

canonical:holding:89.description: Selects the reactive power or power-factor control curve.

canonical:holding:90.label: GPRS modem IP/status flags

canonical:holding:91.description: Grid frequency at which active power derating begins (0.01 Hz increments).

canonical:holding:92.label: Frequency derating slope
canonical:holding:92.description: Slope of the frequency-based active power derating curve. Divide by 10 to obtain percent per hertz.

canonical:holding:93.label: CEI 0-21 Q(V) point V1S

canonical:holding:99.description: Voltage threshold (0.1 V increments) for entering the CEI 0-21 power-factor curve.

canonical:holding:100.label: Power-factor curve lock-out voltage
canonical:holding:100.description: Voltage threshold (0.1 V increments) for leaving the CEI 0-21 power-factor curve.

canonical:holding:102.description: Fixed-point gain (1/4096 increments) applied when constructing the user-defined PF curve.

canonical:holding:148.label: High-voltage derate start
